title: Workbook Round-Trip Verify
description: Loads a Spreadsheet Input Manifest for a run (WORKBOOK-1-BUILD-SPEC.md WB-2), surfaces the ranges to recompute in Excel, accepts a pasted range or CSV back per range, and produces a match/mismatch round-trip receipt (WORKBOOK-ROUNDTRIP-BUILD-SPEC.md XLR-1) naming every diverging cell. Reuses the WB-1 CSV parser and range digest; no second engine.

observedByRef.description: map of manifest range ref to pasted CSV/TSV text (pasted or typed, never fetched)

receipt.description: workbook-roundtrip-receipt: result (match/mismatch), mismatches[], both sides' range digests

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_workbook_roundtrip
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compares a WB-2 Spreadsheet Input Manifest against pasted-back Excel ranges and returns a match/mismatch round-trip receipt naming every diverging cell.
